senses.gloss: to scatter, strew.—Pa. בַּדֵּר same, also, to distribute freely.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 68:31">Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 31</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Chullin 54a:12">Ḥull. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>אי בַּדְּרֵי לה סמא וכ׳</he> if a powder is strewn upon its wound, it may recover; [Rashb. to <cite ref="Bava Batra 74b">B. Bath. 74ᵇ</cite> quotes <he>דעבד ליה סמתרי</he>].
<cite ref="Gittin 56b:17">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>ובַדְּרוּ לקיטמיה וכ׳</he> and scatter ye his (my) ashes over seven waters.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:5:19">Y. Ber. IX, end, 14ᵈ</cite> <he>בשעה דמכנשין בַּדַּר וכ׳</he> when people gather (are willing to listen to instruction), distribute (teach); when people scatter (throw religion away in neglect), gather in (live in retired study).
Cant. R. to VIII, 9 בדרו גרמיכון disperse ye (do not stand in crowds).—Part. pass. מְבַדַּר scattered.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:1:8">Y. M. Kat. III, 81ᵈ</cite> top <he>אית סגין מנהון מְבַדְּרַן וכ׳</he> there are more than those (twenty four cases) scattered in Mishnah and Boraitha.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Amos 9:9">Targ. Amos IX, 9</cite>. [Ibid. <he>מחזרין</he>, prob. <he>מבדרין</he>.] Cmp. <cite ref="B00457"><he>בַּזֵּיל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Micah 6:15">Targ. Mic. VI, 15</cite> (perh. <he>בדד</he>?).

senses.gloss: ; Ithpe. אִיתְבְּדַר, אִיבְּדַר to be scattered, to disperse.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 33:3">Targ. Is. XXXIII, 3</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 20a:9">Sabb. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>קנים מִיבַּדְּרִין</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300, ed. <he>מבדרן</he>) loose staves in the stove will fall apart (and may require stirring).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6">Lev. R. s. 6</cite> and the denars began <he>מִתְבַּדְּרִין</he> to be scattered.
<cite ref="Gittin 33b">Gitt. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>ליבַּרְּרוּ אִיבַּדּוּרֵי</he> (not <he>איבדורו</he>) let them disperse (so as not to be found together).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 8a:15">Snh. 8ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ואיבדור</he> and they (the judges) dispersed.—Denom. <cite ref="B00125"><he>בִּדּוּר</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00125"><he>בִּדּוּרָא</he></cite>.
